author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear pitches the new 2027 Ram 1500 TRX SRT (with a ferocious 777hp) against its biggest rival, the 2026 Ford F-150 Raptor R. The TRX was discontinued a few years back, leaving the 720hp Raptor R as king of the half-ton trucks, but the revival of the SRT performance brand – and the Hemi V8 – means the Hellcat-powered TRX is back, now with its supercharged 6.2-litre engine packing 75hp more. In a series of tests (from a drag race, via rock crawling and whoops, to jumps) which off-road pick-up truck comes out on top? 

🚗 2027 Ram 1500 TRX SRT & 2026 Ford F-150 Raptor R
